title: Evaluation recommendations
description: The evaluators recommended for one agent or deployment, most important first. Written by orq-recommend-evaluators as eval-recommendations-<key>-<timestamp>.json.

grounding.description: What the recommendations rest on, so an empty list still says what backs it.

reason.description: For traces: the total count, how many were read and how many of those had readable text. For error-analysis: the file used. For config-only: the trace count that ruled out traces.

evaluations.description: In rank order, most important first. Empty when nothing is worth adding. The producing skill caps its own list; the data model does not.

name.description: Evaluator key for a new evaluator (kebab-case is the convention), or the existing key for a reused one, which may be spaced Title Case such as "BLEU Score". Any orq evaluator key is accepted.

description.description: What the evaluator checks, in one sentence.

type.description: The orq evaluator type. For a reused evaluator, its existing type.

existing_evaluator_id.description: The id of an existing evaluator to attach as is, or null when a new one is needed.

reason.description: Why it is worth attaching: the consequence of the rule breaking, and the evidence.

caveats.description: What could make this recommendation wrong, such as an incomplete evaluator inventory. Empty when there are none.
